name: follow-ups
description: Who owes me what, and when do I chase them again — reads and writes the local Follow-up Manager database.
long_description:
Connects Claude Desktop to your local Follow-up & Execution Manager. Ask who needs chasing today, see everything you are waiting on grouped by person, create tasks and subtasks, log that you chased someone, and move subtasks between statuses.

It uses the same domain rules as the web app, so the two clocks (how long you have been waiting vs. how long since you last made contact) and the task status roll-up stay identical no matter which one you use. The web app does not need to be running.

tools.name: who_do_i_chase
tools.description: The subtasks that are waiting on someone and have gone quiet past their reminder cooldown

tools.name: waiting_on_summary
tools.description: Everything you are waiting for, grouped by the person who owes it

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: Every task with its derived status and progress

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: One task in full: subtasks, owners, both clocks and latest events

tools.name: list_contacts
tools.description: Who can own a subtask, with ids; marks the default owner

tools.name: create_subtask
tools.description: Add a subtask to a task; owner and requested date default

tools.name: log_reminder
tools.description: Record a follow-up event, resetting the reminder cooldown

tools.name: set_subtask_status
tools.description: Move a subtask to a new status, applying the app's clock rules
